channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: The City of Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League and was the only Florida city selected.

item.title: Juno Beach considers replacing fence at JB-7 beach access after condo residents report trespassing
item.description: A missing fence at a Juno Beach public beach access point has created tension between Colony Condos residents and summer beachgoers, and the town may spend thousands of dollars to replace it.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court challenge Thursday against a judge's recommendation to reinstate a Spectrum Academy teacher suspended last year aft.

item.title: Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive A rating from state
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County received an A rating from the state for the third year in a row, with 143 district-operated schools rated A or B and a record 93.5 percent graduation rate.

item.title: Boca Raton High School band to represent Florida at National Independence Day Parade
item.description: The Boca Raton Community High School band will march down the National Mall in Washington D.C. on July 4 at 10:30 a.m., representing the entire state of Florida.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4 percent this year
item.description: A holiday cookout meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4 percent from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after Anthem denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, and her surgeon are speaking out after her insurance company denied coverage for a reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in home fire days before her birthday
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild.

item.title: Juno Beach fence dispute at JB-7 beach access could cost town thousands
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say people using the JB-7 public walkway are cutting through their private property since the town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons.

item.title: Port St. Lucie advances Midway Road expansion and Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: The Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to FDOT to assist with a partial interchange at the Turnpike.

item.title: Glydways proposes elevated autonomous transit connecting West Palm Beach to airport
item.description: A California-based autonomous transit company will present a proposal to Palm Beach County commissioners Tuesday for an elevated network of self-driving vehicles connecting downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport.

item.title: Martin County maritime teams prepare for hundreds of Fourth of July boaters
item.description: Lt. Brett Harry with Martin County Maritime Response Unit said they're expecting hundreds of boaters to be on the water celebrating this weekend.

item.title: St. Lucie County deputies make 15 DUI arrests in impaired driving operation
item.description: St. Lucie County sheriff's deputies targeted impaired driving ahead of the Fourth of July weekend.

item.title: Port St. Lucie expands Midway Road with $95 million project, adds Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved giving 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange on the Florida Turnpike as part of the Midway Road Widening Project.

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock to close July 6 for $3 million renovation, nearly doubling slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to be complete by next Fourth of July.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in home fire as community rallies to support fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.

item.title: Tee Box virtual golf center near Delray Beach delayed 3 months, costs $90,000 after contractor problems
item.description: Tom Molen, owner of Tee Box virtual golf training center on Jog Road south of Linton Boulevard, said contractor problems delayed his opening by three months and cost him $90,000.

item.title: Breast cancer patient denied reconstruction coverage hours before surgery despite federal law
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, was denied coverage by Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield for reconstruction surgery less than 24 hours before it was scheduled, despite having invasive ductal carcinoma.

item.description: A Fourth of July cookout for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football program is working through the summer with a clear objective: winning a state championship during the 2026 fall season. item.title: Martin County maritime units deploy two boats with medics for Fourth of July boating weekend
item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit will have two boats staffed with medics stationed in the north and south areas of the county as hundreds of boaters celebrate the holiday weekend on the water.

item.title: Martin County School Board challenges judge recommendation to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court document Thursday arguing that a judge erred in recommending the reinstatement of Matt Theobald, a Spectrum Academy teacher suspended after social media comments about Charlie Kirk.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman remembered after deadly home fire as community supports fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, died Monday in a home fire in Hobe Sound that preliminary findings suggest may have been caused by an electrical issue. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild.

item.title: Port St. Lucie advances $95 million Midway Road widening project and Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: The Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance last month to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange at the Florida Turnpike.

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after Anthem Blue Cross denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, had her breast reconstruction surgery denied by Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield less than 24 hours before the scheduled procedure because the insurance company considers the surgical mesh GalaFlex investigational.

item.title: Lantana veteran gets lien removed and roof repaired after contractor issues
item.description: Stephen McCoy, a disabled and retired veteran in Lantana, had a nearly $7,000 lien placed on his home after his roofing contractor allegedly failed to pay for materials, but the lien was lifted after WPTV contacted the company.

item.title: North Palm Beach celebrates Fourth of July with fireworks and America 250 events at country club
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with a full day of activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.description: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach is offering educational and interactive programs during peak sea turtle nesting season through September. item.description: Florida's State Board of Education has voted to move forward with rules that would prevent undocumented students from enrolling in the state's 28 community colleges and adult education programs. item.title: Byron Donalds reports raising more than $90 million as Florida GOP governor's race intensifies
item.description: U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds' campaign and affiliated political committee say they have now raised more than $90 million this cycle, including more than $23 million in the second quarter.

item.title: Gov. DeSantis allies accuse Lt. Gov. Jay Collins' wife of running anonymous social media accounts critical of the governor
item.description: Multiple X accounts were suddenly deactivated after allegations they were tied to Layla Collins, wife of Lt. Gov. Jay Collins, in accusations that came from prominent veterans of Gov. Ron DeSantis' communications team.

item.title: St. Petersburg unveils $8.1 billion plan to transform Tropicana Field site into mixed-use district
item.description: A new civic park, a permanent home for The Woodson African American Museum of Florida, and thousands of income-restricted housing units sit at the center of The Burg Bid's vision for redeveloping Tropicana Field and the surrounding Historic Gas Plant District.

item.title: Florida Secretary of State asks court to keep Republican candidate Paula Stark off the ballot after missing filing deadline
item.description: Secretary of State Cord Byrd is asking the courts to keep Stark off the ballot as he sought to cast doubt on her claims about an alleged paperwork mix-up that ended up disqualifying her.

item.description: Deputies report that the body of a missing diver was found on the Florida coast near Fort Pierce Inlet.

item.title: Driver held Port St. Lucie teens at gunpoint after Orbeez pellet shooting incident
item.description: A driver held teenagers at gunpoint after they shot Orbeez pellets at his car in Port St. Lucie, police say.

item.description: Two people were rescued after their boat sank in the Intracoastal Waterway in St. Lucie County.
